name: ZIP
notes: methods JPEG (96), WavPack (97) and PKWARE strong encryption unsupported (ZipReader.cs)

name: Comic Book Archive
notes: .cbt (tar) and .cba (ACE) have no descriptor

name: 7z
notes: Deflate64, ARM64, RISC-V, Zstd/Brotli/LZ4 coders and external header references unsupported (SevenZipReader.cs)

name: XAR (eXtensible ARchive)
notes: every xar encoding (none, gzip/zlib, bzip2, lzma, xz) decoded and checked against the TOC checksum; verified on bsdtar-written archives

name: Xar Image Format (PRONOM fmt/922)
notes: PRONOM lists this separately from eXtensible ARchive

name: Compiled HTML Help (CHM)
notes: content sections above 1 unsupported (ChmReader.cs)

name: ARJ
notes: methods 0-4 decoded; method 4 verified on archives the open-source ARJ port wrote

name: LHA / LZH
notes: every method and header level of lhasa's test suite reads except LHARK's lk7; lh2, lh3, lhx, pm1 and pm2 are read-only; self-extracting executables are not opened (LhaReader.cs)

name: ALZip
notes: store and deflate only (AlZipReader.cs)

name: EGG (ALZip)
notes: store and deflate only; bzip2/LZMA/AZO, encryption and split archives unsupported (EggReader.cs)

name: StuffIt (classic + 5)
notes: store and RLE only; LZW/Huffman/LZAH/Arsenic/DES methods throw (StuffItReader.cs)

name: StuffIt X
notes: stored and deflate only; Brimstone/Cyanide/Darkhorse/Iron throw (StuffItXReader.cs)

name: DiskDoubler
notes: single files only (no DDAR/DDA2 archives); methods 0, 1, 6, 9 decoded and checked against unar on real files; 2-5, 7, 8, 10 and delta refused (DiskDoublerReader.cs)

name: Compact Pro
notes: stored and RLE only; LZ+RLE and LZ+Huffman unsupported (CompactProReader.cs)

name: PackIt
notes: real layout (PMag/PMa4, header and fork CRC-16) verified on real archives against unar; encrypted PMa5/PMa6 entries refused (PackItReader.cs)

name: HA
notes: stored only; HSC and ASC throw (HaReader.cs)

name: UHARC
notes: stored and LZP only (UharcReader.cs)

name: FreeArc
notes: only storing and lzma blocks decode; tornado/ppmd/lzp/grzip/rep/delta/exe and encryption are refused (FreeArcMethods.cs)

name: ZPAQ
notes: reads only the stored blocks our own writer emits; ZPAQL-compressed blocks (every real zpaq level) throw (ZpaqReader.cs)

name: PAQ (paq6/7/8 family)
notes: a single PAQ8 variant (.paq8l); the other PAQ versions are mutually incompatible

name: PEA (PeaZip)
notes: https://peazip.github.io/pea-file-format.html

name: Apple Archive (.aar)
notes: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applearchive

name: Mozilla ARchive (MAR)
notes: https://wiki.mozilla.org/Software_Update:MAR

name: SeqBox
notes: https://github.com/MarcoPon/SeqBox

name: BagIt
notes: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8493

name: PHP archive (PHAR)
notes: https://www.php.net/manual/en/phar.fileformat.php

name: pack (.z, Huffman)
notes: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pack_(compression)

name: MS-DOS COMPRESS (KWAJ)
notes: methods 2 (LZSS) and 3 (LZ+Huffman) throw (KwajStream.cs)

name: xMash (Amiga)
notes: our earlier descriptor used an invented layout and was removed; the real format packs every cylinder with XPK, no decoder here implements XPK, and unar leaves libxad's client for it out

name: DCS (Amiga Disk Archiver)
notes: our earlier descriptor used an invented layout and was removed; the real format packs every cylinder with XPK, no decoder here implements XPK, and unar leaves libxad's client for it out

name: RAR audio / VM filters
notes: RAR3 filters matched to the six standard programs only; no general RarVM (Rar3Decoder.cs)

name: DiskDoubler methods (ADn/DDn/Method2)
notes: ADn (6, 9) decoded; DDn and Method 2 refused (DiskDoublerAdDecoder.cs)

name: tar sparse files
notes: GNU/PAX sparse members are not hole-reconstructed (TarReader.cs)

name: Encoded text (uu/xx/b64/BinHex/yEnc)
notes: no XXEncode descriptor

name: NSIS installer
notes: LZMA behind the x86 branch filter refused; uninstaller payload not listed (NsisReader.cs)

name: Inno Setup
notes: listing only; file extraction throws for every Inno version (InnoSetupReader.cs)

name: ISO 9660 (Joliet / Rock Ridge / El Torito)
notes: Rock Ridge names (NM+CE), symlinks (SL), relocated directories (RE/CL) and zisofs (ZF) decoded; PX/TF not surfaced; interleaved files throw (IsoReader.cs)

name: UDF
notes: type-1 partition maps only: no VAT/sparable/metadata partitions (UDF 1.50+ media) (UdfReader.cs)

name: Linux LVM2
notes: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/lvm.8.html

name: Android logical partitions (super.img)
notes: https://source.android.com/docs/core/ota/dynamic_partitions

name: Apple Disk Copy 4.2
notes: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disk_Copy

name: VHDX
notes: differencing disks read through the parent locator and sector bitmaps (checked against libvhdi); an unreplayed log is refused

name: VMDK
notes: reads streamOptimized, monolithic/split sparse, flat and delta disks (checked against qemu-img); in-place edits only on plain monolithicSparse

name: QCOW / QCOW2
notes: no encryption, backing files, zstd clusters or extended L2 (Qcow2Structures.cs)

name: Android boot image
notes: mkbootimg/unpack_bootimg byte-identical oracle; vendor_boot v3/v4 included

name: EnCase / Expert Witness (E01)
notes: single segment only (no .E02+), no L01 logical evidence, no Ex01 (EwfReader.cs)

name: DMS (Disk Masher)
notes: NONE/SIMPLE/QUICK only; MEDIUM/DEEP/HEAVY1/HEAVY2 throw (DmsReader.cs)

name: PackDisk (Amiga)
notes: our earlier descriptor used an invented layout and was removed; the real DISKPACK layout (libxad) packs cylinders with XPK, and neither a real sample nor a reader that runs here (unar leaves libxad's PackDisk client out) is available to prove an implementation

name: xDisk (Amiga)
notes: our earlier descriptor used an invented layout and was removed; the real format packs every cylinder with XPK, no decoder here implements XPK, and unar leaves libxad's client for it out

name: Android Verified Boot (vbmeta)
notes: hash + RSA signature verified on read; unsigned (NONE) images written byte-identical to avbtool; signed images read-only

name: LUKS encrypted volume
notes: https://gitlab.com/cryptsetup/cryptsetup/-/wikis/home

name: Windows PE
notes: archive view of resources/overlay, not a full PE section extractor

name: Windows thumbnail cache
notes: Thumbs.db only; thumbcache_*.db has no descriptor

name: RPG Maker archives
notes: RGSSAD v1-3 only; MV/MZ asset encryption (.rpgmv*) has no descriptor

name: Unity assets / bundles
notes: UnityFS bundles only; .unitypackage (tar.gz) and serialized-file internals are not handled

name: APFS
notes: no decmpfs (LZVN/LZFSE) compressed files, no encryption (ApfsReader.cs)

name: Btrfs
notes: zlib/lzo/zstd compressed extents decoded; checked against kernel-written volumes (Btrfs/ReferenceVectors)

name: UFS / FFS (BSD), UFS2
notes: UFS1 only; UFS2 (magic 0x19540119) is not recognised

name: Fossil (Plan 9)
notes: writer not yet proven against the fossil server

name: NTFS
notes: WOF (XPRESS/LZX) compressed files not decoded; LZNT1 is

name: Record-oriented mainframe FS (CMS, MTS, VSAM, Pick, z/OS access methods, ...)
SquashFS
notes: SquashFS v4 only; v1-v3 rejected (SquashFsSuperblock.cs)

name: MPQ
notes: zlib and bzip2 blocks only; PKWare DCL, Huffman, ADPCM, LZMA and sparse blocks are refused (MpqReader.cs)

name: VDFS
notes: Gothic ZenGin VDF, stored and Union-zipped (zlib ZippedStream); ZenKit reads what we write, GothicVDFS/VDFSTool volumes read (docs/VDFS-ON-DISK.md)
